# bob capture-related

List existing tasks that a new capture may duplicate

```text title="bob capture-related --help"
List existing tasks that each new task in a capture draft may duplicate or relate to.

The command is read-only and never writes the vault. This release ships the --query evaluation harness: TEXT is ranked as one new task title against every open task in routable notes, plus tasks closed in the last --days days. Pass --format json to emit schema_version 1 with a score on each match.

Usage: bob capture-related [OPTIONS] --query <TEXT>

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -d, --days <N>
          Also match tasks closed in the last N days
          
          [default: 30]

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json
          
          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -l, --limit <N>
          Matches per item
          
          [default: 5]

  -q, --query <TEXT>
          Rank TEXT as one new task title (evaluation harness)

Examples:
  bob capture-related --query "Install UPS battery"
  bob capture-related -q "Install UPS battery" -f json
  bob capture-related -q "Install UPS battery" -d 14 -l 3
  bob capture-related -b ~/bob -q "Install UPS battery"

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override for the closed-task window
```
